csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using UnityEngine.UI; using System.Text; using UnityEditor; public class Script { public static string Main() { var sb = new StringBuilder(); string[] paths = new string[] { "Assets/Art/In-Game UI/Icon - Spin.png", "Assets/Art/In-Game UI/S_Controls_Ball_GOLFIN.png", "Assets/Art/In-Game UI/S_Menu_Driver_GOLFIN.png" }; foreach (var p in paths) { var imp = AssetImporter.GetAtPath(p) as TextureImporter; if (imp == null) { sb.AppendLine(p + ": NO IMPORTER"); continue; } bool wasReadable = imp.isReadable; imp.isReadable = true; imp.SaveAndReimport(); var tex = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Texture2D>(p); if (tex == null) { sb.AppendLine(p + ": NO TEX"); continue; } var pixels = tex.GetPixels32(); int w = tex.width; int h = tex.height; var corners = new Color32[] { pixels[0], pixels[w-1], pixels[(h-1)*w], pixels[h*w-1] }; sb.Append(System.IO.Path.GetFileName(p) + " " + w + "x" + h + " corners:"); foreach (var c in corners) sb.Append(" rgba(" + c.r + "," + c.g + "," + c.b + "," + c.a + ")"); sb.AppendLine(); imp.isReadable = wasReadable; imp.SaveAndReimport(); } return sb.ToString(); } }
